principle: Allow traversal. Meter disclosure. Enforce quota. Detect sustained extraction.
relationship_semantics: Existing canonical relation codes are preserved; codes do not imply data coverage.

identity.position: existing UUID plus chain_version_id; external_id is not globally unique
identity.relationship: Use the full typed relationship_ref returned by the API.
identity.participation_facets: subject=company-to-subject; position=subject-to-position in that SAME canonical participation. Neither creates a standalone placement or supplier fact.

capabilities.world_overview: Fixed lightweight world graph exposing current visible company/product/business/position identities and typed participation/company/structure links. Deep facts/evidence/source content stay behind drill-down; no rotating view or overview pagination.
capabilities.canonical_intelligence_delivery: Current canonical facts, participations, company relationships and structural relations are researchable after the single intake review. Historical evidence/review labels remain visible quality state rather than a second Agent publication gate; explicit withdrawal or denial remains blocked.
capabilities.source_delivery: Sources are citation/evidence references, not an enumerable intelligence corpus; source metadata/content remains permission-filtered.
capabilities.diversity: Different node-ID routes plus edge overlap filtering; aliases still require semantic interpretation.
capabilities.negative_relation_coverage: Only existing qualified canonical relations; unsupported/missing relations are not fabricated.

operations.name: get_world_overview
operations.description: Orient yourself in the whole published industry network before choosing keywords. Returns visible lightweight company/product/business/position identities and the typed relationship skeleton connecting them, plus category summaries. Fact text, evidence/source bodies and commercial values require drill-down; there is no rotating sample or overview pagination.

WorldOverviewBudget.description: Fixed larger envelope for the one-shot lightweight world graph only.
WorldOverviewBudget.title: WorldOverviewBudget

input_schema.description:
One fixed lightweight graph of a published industry network.

No entity filters, time slicing, alternate projections, random seeds or
pagination. It may expose visible node identity plus typed relationship
skeletons, but not deep fact/evidence/source payloads. Repeating this
operation cannot reveal a rotating sample.
input_schema.title: WorldOverviewQuery

operations.name: search_entities
operations.description: Resolve names, aliases, tickers or scoped product terms to canonical typed IDs. For unknown research space, get_world_overview gives orientation and list_changes gives recent changes. No wildcard or whole-database listing.

operations.name: get_entities
operations.description: Reopen explicit typed entity references, including existing position UUIDs and chain versions. Identity is not evidence of participation, orders or commercial stage.

operations.name: list_changes
operations.description: Discover recent canonical changes without naming candidates, or track an explicit set with a checkpoint. SIJI publication time, business event time and valid time are distinct. Missing history is explicit.

operations.name: expand_graph
operations.description: Explore any returned node again, in either direction and across supported chains. Traverse filters and returned-node filters are independent. Also reopens exact relationship refs or inspects edges inside an explicit node set. Structural adjacency does not prove company transactions.

NodeFilter.description: Explicit filters; result filters and traversal filters are separate.
NodeFilter.title: NodeFilter

operations.name: trace_paths
operations.description: Find bounded evidence-qualified graph connections with ordered waypoints, excluded nodes/edges and diverse alternatives. The agent interprets possible propagation. Paths are not causal proof; partial does not mean no path.

NodeFilter.description: Explicit filters; result filters and traversal filters are separate.
NodeFilter.title: NodeFilter

operations.name: get_facts
operations.description: Reopen exact fact_ids or inspect qualified facts for explicit entities. Preserve status, inference, time, scope, conflicts and citations. A seen node ID does not grant all of its facts.

operations.name: get_evidence
operations.description: Reopen fact/relationship citations or exact source-version references. Citation permissions and source-content permissions are separate. Do not guess source URLs or treat metadata as full-text authorization.

operations.name: compare
operations.description: Align explicit candidates' qualified commercial facts without choosing an investment winner. Missing values are unknown, not zero; periods and units remain explicit.

interpretation: The caller plans the research; no industry(question) conversion occurs.
Returned reference IDs are counted as disclosure, even inside paths and frontier metadata.
Request work limits do not ban recursive traversal or BFS.
Rights restrictions, commercial quota, work limits and abuse decisions are distinct.
Unsupported evidence, absent paths and partial coverage must remain visible as uncertainty.
